name: Cyberpunk Trading Card Game
note: Machine-readable deck-construction constraints for the future Pawpawko deck-builder. The prose rules live in cyberpunk_rules.md. Card data lives in public.cards where game='cyberpunk' (legends are type='Legend'; RAM in column ram; color in column color).

legends.comment: Exactly 3 Legend cards, each with a different name. They sit in their own Legends area and are NOT counted toward the main-deck size.

main_deck_size.comment: No fewer than 40 and no more than 50 cards, not including the 3 Legends.

max_copies_per_card.comment: No more than 3 copies of the same card.

ram_constraint.rule: For every non-Legend card in the deck: card.ram <= sum(legend.ram for legend in deck.legends where legend.color == card.color).
ram_constraint.details: Each Legend grants a RAM limit only toward its own color. A deck's per-color RAM cap is the cumulative RAM of the Legends sharing that color. A card may be included only if its RAM value is <= the cap for its color. Cards whose color has no matching Legend (cap = 0) cannot be included.

example.meaning: Deck may include Green cards with RAM <= 4 and Red cards with RAM <= 2; no Blue or Yellow cards (cap 0).

legality_flag.comment: Source-reported per-card legality (e.g. 'legal'). Exclude any card whose legality is not 'legal' once a ban/restricted list exists.

reference.win_condition: Start a turn with 7+ Gig dice in your Gig area. Overtime (sudden death, majority wins) begins after the last player's 7th turn.
reference.lose_condition: Deck out: if you must draw with an empty deck, your Rival immediately wins.

core_resources.eddies: Currency. Pay a card's cost (top-left number) by spending Eddies. Create Eddies by selling cards with a Sell tag (1 Eddie/turn). Legends may also be spent as 1 Eddie each.
core_resources.gigs: Dice that represent jobs; controlling a majority wins.
core_resources.street_cred: Sum of your Gig dice face values; gates some effects.
core_resources.ram: Deck-building resource only (not paid in-game) — see ram_constraint.
